headline: InterDigital Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates Despite Lower Y/Y Revenues
summary: IDCC tops Q2 2026 estimates as a new Amazon licensing agreement boosts streaming revenues, even as smartphone licensing sales and earnings decline.

headline: Stay Ahead of the Game With Motorola (MSI) Q2 Earnings: Wall Street's Insights on Key Metrics
summary: Beyond analysts' top-and-bottom-line estimates for Motorola (MSI), evaluate projections for some of its key metrics to gain a better insight into how the business might have performed for the quarter ended June 2026.
